question: What is the typical threshold for infrequent bowel movements defining constipation in pregnancy?

options.A: One bowel movement every two weeks
options.B: Absence of stool for twenty-four hours
options.C: Fewer than three bowel movements a week
options.D: Passing stool only after taking medication

explanation: Clinical guidelines define constipation as passing fewer than three stools per week alongside hard consistency and straining. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h1)

question: At what stage of pregnancy do women most commonly begin experiencing constipation?

options.B: Starting as early as the first trimester
options.C: Only in the immediate postpartum period

explanation: Rising hormone levels begin affecting gastrointestinal motility very early in gestation, making the first trimester a common onset period. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h1)

question: Which hormone is primarily responsible for slowing down gastrointestinal motility during pregnancy?
explanation: Progesterone relaxes smooth muscles throughout the body, including the intestinal tract, which slows down food passage. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h2)

question: How does slowed intestinal transit time directly affect stool consistency?

options.A: It has no impact on the water content of waste
options.B: It allows the colon to absorb more water, producing hard stool
options.C: It increases mucus production, making stools watery
options.D: It prevents water absorption, causing severe diarrhea

explanation: When waste sits longer in the colon, extra water is extracted, leading to dry and difficult-to-pass stool. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h2)

question: Which routine antenatal supplement is a major contributor to constipation in pregnant women?
explanation: Iron supplements commonly cause gastrointestinal irritation and hardening of the stool during pregnancy. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h3)

question: How does reduced physical activity contribute to sluggish bowel movements in expectant mothers?

options.A: It forces the stomach to empty too rapidly into the colon
options.B: It slows down overall bodily metabolism and intestinal motility
options.C: It directly increases the absorption of dietary fats
options.D: It causes the liver to stop producing digestive enzymes

explanation: Physical movement stimulates peristalsis, so a sedentary lifestyle worsens the already sluggish bowel transit caused by hormones. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h3)

question: What is a common subjective complaint reported by a pregnant patient experiencing constipation?

options.A: Sudden inability to keep any fluids down
options.B: Sharp chest pain radiating to the jaw

explanation: Patients frequently describe straining and a lingering sensation that the bowel has not emptied completely. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h4)

question: Why is a detailed medication review essential during a constipation assessment in pregnancy?

options.A: To check if the patient is taking illegal substances
options.B: To determine the blood type of the mother
options.C: To identify common culprits like iron supplements that harden stool
options.D: To calculate the exact weight gain of the fetus

explanation: Many routine antenatal vitamins contain iron, which directly contributes to hard stools and difficult evacuation. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h4)

question: Which painful vascular condition is frequently caused or worsened by straining during pregnancy?
explanation: Increased intra-abdominal pressure from straining combined with pelvic venous congestion easily leads to hemorrhoids. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h5)

question: What is fecal impaction in the context of untreated pregnancy constipation?

options.A: Complete stoppage of all digestive enzymes
options.B: A large mass of dry, hard stool stuck in the rectum
options.C: Sudden twisting of the colon loop
options.D: An infection of the small intestine lining

explanation: Impactions occur when hardened stool accumulates and cannot be expelled naturally by peristalsis. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h5)

question: What is the primary first-line approach for managing constipation in pregnancy?

options.D: Immediate surgical evacuation of the colon

explanation: Non-pharmacological measures like fluids, fiber, and walking are always tried before turning to medications. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h6)

question: A pregnant patient complains of hard stools despite eating fiber. What essential instruction should the nurse add?

options.A: Lie completely flat on the back for two hours
options.C: Take double doses of iron tablets
options.D: Increase daily fluid intake to help the fiber work properly

explanation: Fiber requires adequate water in the gastrointestinal tract to bulk and soften the stool; without fluids, fiber can worsen constipation. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h6)

question: Which class of laxatives is generally considered the safest first choice when medications are needed in pregnancy?
explanation: Bulk-forming agents act locally by absorbing water and are not absorbed into the bloodstream, making them very safe. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h7)

question: Why should castor oil be avoided for treating constipation during pregnancy?

options.A: It can stimulate uterine contractions and lead to preterm labor
options.B: It permanently damages the lining of the stomach
options.C: It causes immediate complete kidney failure
options.D: It turns the stool completely white

explanation: Castor oil triggers smooth muscle contractions in both the bowels and the uterus, posing a risk of premature labor. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h7)

question: Why is it important to advise pregnant patients not to ignore the urge to defecate?

options.A: It stops the baby from receiving oxygen
options.B: Suppressing the urge allows more water absorption, hardening the stool
options.C: It causes the appendix to rupture immediately
options.D: It permanently weakens the bladder sphincter

explanation: Ignoring the defecation reflex desensitizes the rectum and lets the colon extract more moisture from the waste. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h8)

question: What is a primary goal of antenatal patient education regarding bowel habits?

options.A: Eliminating all iron supplements from the diet completely
options.B: Ensuring the patient takes daily strong enemas
options.C: Preventing constipation through early dietary and fluid awareness
options.D: Teaching the patient how to perform manual stool removal

explanation: Proactive education helps women modify their routines early, preventing severe discomfort and complications later. [learn more](GNS226_U2_T015#GNS226_U2_T015_h8)
